newsitem.title: POLAND: U.S. GRAIN FIRM, POLISH FEED PLANT IN JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: U.S. GRAIN FIRM, POLISH FEED PLANT IN JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: The European subsidiary of the U.S. Continental Grain Company and Polish feed plant HUPP Grodkow have created a joint venture company to produce high quality animal feed in Poland, the U.S. firm said on Friday.
Continental Grain's Warsaw office said in a statement that the joint venture, called Contipasz, would start operating on August 4 and produce 110,000 tonnes of animal feed annually.
A modernisation scheme which Contipasz wants to implement would boost ouptput to 150,000 tonnes.
The firm's press office declined to give financial details of the investment or venture.
